label: Estate Frontier Survey and Game-Trail Overlap Pass
completed_scope: Ten additional durable macro estates surveyed and source-prepared, plus the complete current game-trail corpus rerun from every estate to its first typed overlap, shared custody, shared source infrastructure, bounded non-overlap, or unresolved boundary.
boundaries: A surveyed and prepared estate has a declared denominator, official source plan, null controls, stopping rules, and next acquisition; it does not claim that source records were acquired.
A typed overlap routes human evidence review and does not establish influence, coordination, control, causation, or wrongdoing.
Shared custody is a reversible corpus crosswalk and shared source infrastructure is an acquisition dependency; neither creates subject adjacency.
A bounded non-overlap applies only to the declared current trail surface and is not evidence of real-world absence.
No game trail generates a claim, graph edge, score, allegation, report conclusion, or publication approval.
